The native code is NOT changed; see the end. Commit 74951a60fd on jusprin-newui, not pushed. Design System 1793133100-b072, canvas 1793133150-3281.

CODE (built Agent and Home pages, each button injected into the built page so it uses the real stylesheet and tokens; before → after):
- proposal Reject 34px/14px → 32/13; tool-card Reject 34/14 → 32/13; history action 34/14 → 32/13; attachment Remove 34/14 → 32/13; revert Cancel 38/14 → 32/13.
- agent-row-action, prefs-button, welcome-account-action 30/13 → 32/13 (inset ring, no border, no height before).
- dialog buttons, Stop, Home Import, Launch monitor, Home New were already right; they now also take the height token.
- Primaries in the same rows were also off the 34px rule Kenneth set for primaries, so I fixed them too: tool-card Apply 36/14 bold → 34/13, "Revert to here" 38/14 regular → 34/13 bold (now the primary recipe; its row centres the pair), project-updates "Restore and resume" 36 → 34, failed-message Retry 36 → 34. The last two came from 4762d14d17 too.
- Every secondary rule takes min-height from --button-secondary-height. Home's compact New got min-height from the small token, because the new min-height would otherwise beat its 28px height.
- Tests: 13 new recipe checks in AgentUI styles.test.ts plus 1 in HomeUI; all 14 fail on the previous stylesheets. Agent 615 tests and Home 84 tests pass.
- Docs: design-system.md now says the conversation's card text is Body but buttons are not: secondary Body Small at 32 DIP, primary Body Small Bold at 34 DIP everywhere, card buttons included (decided 2026-10-27).

DESIGN SYSTEM: bundle.js dropped textStyle 'body' from ChatAttachment Remove and ChatToolActivity Reject, and 'body-bold' from ChatToolActivity Approve (it drew 36px). There were no other overrides on ButtonSecondary or ButtonPrimary. Measured with React rendering old vs new bundle: Remove 32/14 → 32/13, Reject 32/14 → 32/13, Approve 36/14 → 34/13. The README rule and the ButtonSecondary guide now say the same as the doc; lastChange set.

CANVAS: the compact Stop in comp-composer now uses a body-small label. Measured all 134 boards, with the label's computed font size: 82 secondary at 32px and 6 compact secondary at 28px (4 Stop, 2 New), 75 primary at 34px and 75 Send at 28px, all 13px. None differ. Pixel check: of comp-composer and the 47 boards that import it, only comp-composer changed (the Stop label); the other 47 are identical. Copied tokens.json, tokens.css, bundle.css and bundle.js from the Design System into project/ds/jusprin/ and bumped the designSystems record to 1793133100-b072. Read-back hashes match.

NOTE for Kenneth: someone changed the frame of agent-ui-01 (timeline-cards · manufacturing history state matrix) from 2774px to 772px tall in the page, which cuts off most of the board. I kept it as found.

NOT CHANGED, native (needs a decision and an app build):
- The print-issue bubble (IssueOverlay.cpp) draws "Ask AI" (secondary recipe) beside "Resolve with AI" (primary). Both are sized line + 2 × max(padding) = the canvas font's line + 16, in the 3D canvas's single ImGui font, not the token text roles. Bringing Ask AI to 13px/32 means adding a second ImGui font and giving the pair different heights.

=== c539df76ca
Point the design docs at the new JusPrin v2 canvas

The canvas was rebuilt on 2026-10-27 so that the setup card, chat
header, composer, printer-and-spool chip and the other repeated pieces
are drawn once, on its Compositions page, and every screen imports
them. The old canvas is frozen as history.

Rule 5 of "Writing UI code" names the new canvas and the frozen one, a
ninth handoff rule says to draw a repeated composition once on the
Compositions page, and the governance reference says where such
compositions live.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01KKDa7Dwrqv5wdpJVzLKdVp


 .claude/skills/figma-agent-design/SKILL.md                       | 2 +-
 .../figma-agent-design/references/design-system-governance.md    | 2 ++
 agent-docs/jusprin/design-system.md                              | 9 ++++++---
 3 files changed, 9 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)
=== 5016d406a6
Let the Agent and Home dev servers serve icons and fonts

With JUSPRIN_AGENT_DEV_URL or JUSPRIN_HOME_DEV_URL set, the pages load from
the Vite dev server, and every icon and the HarmonyOS Sans font were missing:
the CSS points at resources/jusprin/ui/icons/ and WebShared/fonts/, both
outside each page's folder, and Vite refuses those files (403, "outside of
Vite serving allow list").

server.fs.allow now lists those two folders beside Vite's default workspace
root. Other files on disk are still refused. Production builds are
byte-identical with the old and new config.

Entire-Checkpoint: 01M5X9S7PVKENFCNSDH2TNZBWV


 src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/AgentUI/vite.config.ts | 16 +++++++++++++---
 src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/HomeUI/vite.config.ts  | 16 +++++++++++++---
 2 files changed, 26 insertions(+), 6 deletions(-)
=== 7963c4c53b
Give the regular buttons their heights in the token file

The design system states 32 DIP for a secondary button and 34 DIP for a
primary or split button, but the token file only carried their padding.
Secondary and primary now carry those heights, and a split recipe is
added at the primary's height. Nothing reads the new keys yet; the web
pages gain --button-secondary-height, --button-primary-height and
--button-split-height variables.

The brand test pins the recipes and checks that each height is the
padding plus the text role's line height (plus the 1 DIP outline on
each side for secondary), so the stated height and the drawn button
cannot drift apart.

Entire-Checkpoint: 01M5XZBYT4KXSVR0FWSTVT4EAW


 resources/jusprin/ui/design-tokens.json |  7 +++++++
 tests/brand/test_brand_tokens.cpp       | 28 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 35 insertions(+)
=== 74951a60fd
Draw every secondary button at Body Small and 32 DIP

Commit 4762d14d17 moved the Agent conversation to Body, card buttons
included, so secondary buttons in the thread drew 14px text at 34 DIP
(38 in the revert popover), and three outlined buttons drawn with an
inset ring stood 30 DIP. Kenneth decided on 2026-10-27 that every
secondary button is Body Small at 32 DIP and every primary button Body
Small Bold at 34 DIP, chat cards included; only the cards' text stays
at Body.

Agent page:
- Secondary buttons (proposal and tool-card Reject, history action,
  attachment Remove, revert Cancel) use Body Small.
- Every secondary rule, including the Agent rows, Preferences and
  Welcome buttons, takes min-height from --button-secondary-height.
- The tool-card Apply, project-updates Restore, failed-message Retry and
  revert confirm primaries use Body Small Bold; the revert confirm uses
  the primary recipe, and its row centres the pair.

Home page: the outlined buttons take the same height token; the compact
New keeps 28 DIP from its own.

Measured in the built pages (buttons injected into the page with its real
stylesheet and tokens): every secondary button is 32 px with 13px text,
compact ones 28 px, every primary 34 px. Before, they ranged 30 to 38 px.

styles.test.ts guards each rule's height token and text role; the 13 new
Agent checks and the Home check fail on the previous stylesheets.
design-system.md states the rule.
